ace.name: Ace
ace.description: If this unit has not moved, the first standard shot costs 0 AP.

acid-tech.name: Acid Tech
acid-tech.description: Acid grenades/spit damage armor on impact equal to 25% of armor HP (max 5, bypasses DR). Shots gain a 35% chance (100% if steadied) to apply corrosion.

aggression.name: Aggression
aggression.description: Shots gain +5% crit damage per enemy in sight.

blast.name: Blast
blast.description: Grants +20% radius and +1 damage to explosives. Does not affect Gravity Mines.

brawler.name: Brawler
brawler.description: Grants +4 armor HP. While idle: Melee attacks graze (dealing only half of the original damage).

breacher.name: Breacher
breacher.description: The first grenade use each turn costs 0 AP but reduces mobility to 3.3 tiles until it has no AP remaining or the end of the turn. This soldier's grenades gain +50% base weapon damage and do not damage this soldier but have -70% range. Equipped grenades receive an additional use and have no weight.

bring-em-on.name: Bring 'Em On
bring-em-on.description: For each enemy in sight: this unit gains +0.5 damage on standard shots and incoming non-psionic attacks have a +5% graze chance.

bullseye.name: Bullseye
bullseye.description: Grants +20 aim, +20 crit, +20% crit dmg, and +20 pen to shots fired at 2AP or shots at preoccupied targets (double if both). Grants +1 ammo to primary weapons.

close-encounters.name: Close Encounters
close-encounters.description: The first standard shot against an enemy within 4 tiles will leave this unit with 1 AP but reduces mobility to 3.3 until out of AP. Within 4 tiles: immune to enemy crits and reaction fire, and +25% base weapon damage.

combat-drugs.name: Combat Drugs
combat-drugs.description: Smoke grenades grant +25 aim and +15 crit. On detonation, if this unit is in the Area of Effect, they Enrage. Smoke grenades also passively heal 2 HP at the end of the turn. Only affects units that are breathing the smoke. Does not work in dense smoke.

critical-system-targeting.name: Critical System Targeting
critical-system-targeting.description: Shots against autopsied mechanical units deal +30% damage and gain +30 penetration (+60% damage and +60 penetration if steadied). Does not work with Arc Weapons.

dense-smoke.name: Dense Smoke
dense-smoke.description: Smoke grenades grant an additional +20 defense (+50 defense total -- defense affects psi as well).

disabling-shot.name: Disabling Shot
disabling-shot.description: Fire a 0 AP 1 damage shot that disables the target's main weapon. Grants +1 ammo to primary weapons. Does not work against mechanical targets (except SHIVs). Cannot be used to activate or after activating In The Zone. 3 turn cooldown. Only for Sniper/Strike Rifles.

double-tap.name: Double Tap
double-tap.description: Shooting allows this unit to fire an extra shot if not out of ammo or targets. Any follow-up shots (from Double Tap or not) on a previous target this turn gains +20 aim/crit/pen. 1 turn cooldown after 2nd shot is used. Grants +1 ammo to primary weapons.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: Grants +1 damage and +20 aim against targets at or below half HP. Double the effects if using a sidearm.

extra-conditioning.name: Extra Conditioning
extra-conditioning.description: Grants +2 armor HP, +0.6 mobility, and a 10% chance for all end-in-idle actions to cost 0 AP.

field-medic.name: Field Medic
field-medic.description: Grants 2 medikits. Medikits heal +1 HP. Medikits heal +1 HP when an idle Engineer is within 4 tiles. Stabilization costs 0 AP and no longer consumes a medikit (but still requires one to be available).

fire-rocket.name: Fire Rocket
fire-rocket.description: Grants the ability to use and equip a rocket launcher. Rocket scatter is affected by max base HP. Firing a rocket with 1 AP triples scatter and decreases range by 20%. 2 turn cooldown.

firebase.name: Firebase
firebase.description: When in partial cover: Steadied shots are not broken by damage and deal +50% base weapon damage. If also adjacent to a SHIV: Gain +20% throw range and automatically Steady Weapon if idle at the end of the turn.

fragmentation.name: Fragmentation
fragmentation.description: Explosives critically hit exposed targets and have a 50% increased chance to cause bleeding.

grenadier.name: Grenadier
grenadier.description: Using a destructive grenade deals +1 damage and costs only 1 AP. Equipped destructive grenades and MEC launchers receive an additional use and have no weight.

grit.name: Grit
grit.description: Grants +5 armor HP and %DR equal to a quarter of the % total HP lost.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: Grants a free medikit and +1 ammo to primary weapons. Medikits used on allies heal +2 HP. If this unit's last action was using a medikit, overwatch activates at the end of the turn (except when bleeding or at risk of triggering reaction fire).

heat-warheads.name: HEAT Warheads
heat-warheads.description: Explosives gain +30 penetration and apply 50% more shred.

hit-and-run.name: Hit and Run
hit-and-run.description: The first shot each turn at a preoccupied target, or at a unit damaged this turn, leaves you with 1 AP. That point can only be spent on movement, officer, psionic, or non-arm MEC actions (you can't fire again).

holo-rounds.name: Holo Rounds
holo-rounds.description: Firing at a target holos them for 3 turns [Prevents stealth, incoming shots gain +10 aim and +10 penetration].

impact.name: Impact
impact.description: The primary weapon gains +10 penetration. Its non-reaction shots disable their target's Overwatch and Reactive Targeting Sensors.

in-the-zone.name: In The Zone
in-the-zone.description: Shots gain aim equal to the percent of HP the target is missing. Shooting with a steadied weapon allows this unit to fire chain shots (with a stacking -10 max hit chance) until they run out of ammo or targets. Standard shots (outside an ITZ chain) trigger a free reload.

kitted.name: Kitted
kitted.description: Grants a medikit and a smoke grenade. If this unit does not have a scope, it gains a generic scope (+10 aim). If this unit does not have a plating, it gains a generic plating (+2 armor HP).

light-em-up.name: Light 'Em Up
light-em-up.description: Standard shots cost only 1 AP and gain both +5 penetration and +0.5 damage (rounded down) for each instance of damage their target took this turn.

lock-n-load.name: Lock N' Load
lock-n-load.description: Reloading any weapon costs only 1 AP and dashing automatically reloads the active weapon.

lone-wolf.name: Lone Wolf
lone-wolf.description: Grants 10 aim, crit, def, and crit resist if not within 6 tiles of an allied unit.

low-profile.name: Low Profile
low-profile.description: All partial cover grants the DR and defense benefits of full cover (does not affect impenetrable DR).

magnum.name: Magnum
magnum.description: Sniper rifles, strike rifles, and pistols and gain +50% base weapon damage. Standard and Precision shots passthrough to enemy units behind the target (up to 24 tiles, not amplified by target modifiers).

master-mechanic.name: Master Mechanic
master-mechanic.description: Increases the healing of repair by +4 HP and grants an additional use. Explosive shots that hit friendly SHIVs do not damage this soldier. When in partial cover adjacent to a SHIV: Both this unit and the SHIV gain 20% DR.

mayhem.name: Mayhem
mayhem.description: Suppression damages enemies immediately with a round of suppressive fire and has its cooldown reduced by 1. Suppressive Fire can cause bleeding.

mechanic.name: Mechanic
mechanic.description: Grants 2 uses of Repair. Removes corrosion from all adjacent allies after each action. When in partial cover adjacent to a SHIV: Gain Low Profile and if engineer is idle, steadied, or on overwatch, passively heal the SHIV for 25% of any damage it takes.

on-the-ready.name: On The Ready
on-the-ready.description: Shots gain +35% base weapon damage if this unit is Steadying or Combat Ready. Non-reaction shots grant Combat Readiness. If this unit's last action was a shot or a manual activation of combat readiness, overwatch activates at the end of the turn (except when bleeding or at risk of triggering reaction fire).

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.description: Reaction shots gain +10 aim and can critically hit.

pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
pathfinder.description: Grants +1 battlescanner. If this unit activates enemies while moving, they regain up to 2 AP. Does not apply to covert operatives. Max one activation per turn. Fails if another allied unit acts before the pod finished activating.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Grants +30% throw range and +50% base weapon damage to explosive grenades.

pistolero.name: Pistolero
pistolero.description: Reaction shots from pistols gain +50% base weapon damage, +35 penetration, +35 aim, and the ability to crit. If idle at end of turn, draws their pistol. When wielding a pistol: fire a reaction shot at any enemy within 4 tiles that acts, gain +20 crit resist, and reloads cost only 1 AP. [Pistolero reaction shots bypass half of cover DR/def and require hit chance >30]

precision-shot.name: Precision Shot
precision-shot.description: Fire a shot that has no squadsight penalties, +30 aim, and +30 crit. The shot will never graze. 3 turn cooldown. Only for Strike/Sniper Rifles.

raking-fire.name: Raking Fire
raking-fire.description: Fire 2 additional reaction shots during overwatch. Reaction Fire and Bulletstorm shots that miss have a 50% chance to take suppressive fire. [Suppressive Fire deals 40% standard shot damage]

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: Grants +1 damage to all weapons and equipment, +0.6 mobility, and +10% throw/rocket range. Sidearms additionally gain +1 damage and +10 aim.

rapid-fire.name: Rapid Fire
rapid-fire.description: Fire twice with your primary weapon; accuracy gains above 50% hit chance only contribute half to final hit chance.

rapid-pincers.name: Rapid Pincers
rapid-pincers.description: Grants Rapid Fire and +0.6 mobility. The first Rapid Fire against a pincered enemy will leave this unit with 1 AP but reduces mobility to 3.3 until out of AP.

ready-for-anything.name: Ready for Anything
ready-for-anything.description: At the end of each turn, if this unit did not move and is not bleeding and not at risk of triggering reaction fire, overwatch activates.

reconnaissance.name: Reconnaissance
reconnaissance.description: Displays information on the nearest aliens that are not hiding after each non-dash move. Provides additional information on sneaking aliens. The first battle scanner used each turn costs 0 AP. Grants a free battle scanner. Grants Low Profile.

repair.name: Repair
repair.description: Heal a mechanical unit for 5 HP and remove corrosion.

revive.name: Revive
revive.description: Bring a stabilized soldier back into action at 33% of their max HP for the cost of 1 medikit and 0 AP.

run-and-gun.name: Run and Gun
run-and-gun.description: Activate to allow shooting or overwatching at 0 AP if the last AP was spent moving. When active: gain +25 crit and immunity to reaction fire, but the AP discount from Close Encounters is disabled. 2 turn cooldown. Cannot activate if out of ammo and does not work with the stun rifle.

sapper.name: Sapper
sapper.description: Explosives are more effective against solid structures. They gain +1 damage, +20 penetration, and double environmental damage.

savior.name: Savior
savior.description: Medikits heal an additional 35% of a target's missing HP. Grants +1 charge to equipped medikits. Grants Revive.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.description: Fire an additional reaction shot and gain +20 defense during overwatch. Grants Opportunist.

shadowstep.name: Shadowstep
shadowstep.description: This unit gains +0.6 mobility and does not trigger reaction shots or pursuit when walking (not dashing). After repositioning, shots gain +25% crit damage until next turn.

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.description: All shots gain +15 aim against biological targets. Rapid Fire shots gain +30 aim instead.

shock-and-awe.name: Shock and Awe
shock-and-awe.description: Rockets gain +35% base weapon damage. Equipped Javelin rockets gain an additional use. Grants +20% throw range. Shots made at 2 AP gain +50% base weapon damage.

smoke-and-mirrors.name: Smoke and Mirrors
smoke-and-mirrors.description: Using a support grenade costs only 1 AP and does not trigger reaction shots. Equipped support grenades receive an additional use.

snapshot.name: Snapshot
snapshot.description: Shots do not trigger reaction fire.

sprinter.name: Sprinter
sprinter.description: Grants +1.3 mobility and +10 defense. Doubles damage from Ram.

squadsight.name: Squadsight
squadsight.description: Allows firing with long-range weapons around some obstacles and beyond 18 tiles at targets with a spotter (a unconcealed ally at 0 AP that can see the target). Grants +2 aim per ally (+8 per scout) that can see the target and -5 aim for each tile beyond 18. Overwatch and reaction shots are still limited to 18 tiles. Other abilities that consider the number of enemies in sight will also include any enemies in squadsight.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.description: Provides +3 armor HP, immunity to panic, and reduces injury times by 30%.

suppression.name: Suppression
suppression.description: Suppress [Pinned if protected by cover, suppressive fire if not, no reaction fire, -35 aim, -35% mobility/ability range] targets. Breaks with suppressive fire if the target acts. Requires 2 ammo, and uses the 2nd ammo if the suppression breaks with suppressive fire. 2 turn cooldown. [Suppressive Fire deals 40% standard shot damage]

surgical-targeting.name: Surgical Targeting
surgical-targeting.description: Shots against autopsied targets affected by red fog double the bleed chance and deal 50% more damage.

sustain.name: Sustain
sustain.description: Self-applied medikits cost 0 AP. Grants +2 armor HP. If idle: when taking 3 or more damage passively heal for 1 HP.

tandem-warheads.name: Tandem Warheads
tandem-warheads.description: Explosives employed by this soldier do full damage throughout their area of effect (instead of a decrease down to 50% at their periphery).

tenacious-defense.name: Tenacious Defense
tenacious-defense.description: Grants +2 armor HP. Grants +20 crit resistance when protected by cover.

tinker.name: Tinker
tinker.description: Concussion and psi grenades add 10 shred to their targets. On detonation, smoke grenades remove all shred.

vital-point-targeting.name: Vital Point Targeting
vital-point-targeting.description: When hitting humans or autopsied biological aliens: steadied shots, reaction shots, or shots at targets not protected by cover deal 30% more damage.

will-to-survive.name: Will to Survive
will-to-survive.description: Upgrades cover DR to 60% (does not affect impenetrable DR) but lowers cover defense by 10. Grants Steadfast.

absorption-fields.name: Absorption Fields
absorption-fields.description: Gain +10% DR. Shots from beam weapons (laser/pulse/drone/cyberdisc) lose half their penetration when targeting this unit.

arsenal.name: Arsenal
arsenal.description: Grenade Launchers, Restorative Mists, and Flamethrowers receive +2 uses. Grenades deal +1 damage and Restorative Mists heal 1 more HP. Reloading costs only 1 AP.

awareness.name: Awareness
awareness.description: A state of constant alertness grants this unit +20 defense at all times. Does not apply against attacks from steadied shots.

close-combat-specialist.name: Close Combat Specialist
close-combat-specialist.description: Grants a reaction shot at any enemy within 4 tiles that acts. Reaction shot only activates on enemy's turn, once per enemy. [Basic reaction shots lower cover DR/def by half, cannot crit, and require hit chance >30]

collateral-damage.name: Collateral Damage
collateral-damage.description: Use up to 3 ammo to destroy some cover and deal 30% of base weapon damage per ammo spent in a 5 tile radius up to 8 tiles away. Leaves this unit with 1 AP and reduces mobility to 3.3 until out of AP. Destroys Corpses. 3 turn cooldown.

combined-arms.name: Combined Arms
combined-arms.description: All weapons and equipment deal +1 damage.

dampening-shield.name: Dampening Shield
dampening-shield.description: Grants proximity-based DR from shots against this unit over 10 tiles away (+3% DR per tile further than 10).

dash-and-bash.name: Dash and Bash
dash-and-bash.description: Activate to allow the use of a Kinetic Strike at 0 AP if the last AP was spent moving. When active, KSM attacks gain +80% base weapon damage and disables the AP discount from Onslaught. Cannot activate if out of ammo. 2 turn cooldown.

fortified.name: Fortified
fortified.description: Grants immunity to critical hits. Injury and fatigue times are reduced by 15%.

gattler.name: Gattler
gattler.description: Collateral Damage can fire 4 tiles further, deals 40% of base weapon damage per ammo spent, and has its cooldown reduced by 1 turn.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: This unit cloaks at the beginning of each turn if it can see an enemy, has ammo, and is idle. All cloak/hiding (including from non-Hunter sources) breaks at the end of turn or after a non-movement action. When cloaked, shots gain +50% base weapon damage and +30 crit. Grants Combined Arms.

jetboot-module.name: Jetboot Module
jetboot-module.description: When activated, grants +3.3 mobility and the ability to jump to normally inaccessible heights for the rest of the turn. 1 turn cooldown. Does not break hidden abilities (Cloaking, Shadow, Stealth, or Ghosting).

onslaught.name: Onslaught
onslaught.description: The first Kinetic Strike each turn will leave this unit with 1 AP but reduces mobility to 3.3 until out of AP. Grants immunity to Pincer. Grants Ram.

pyro.name: Pyro
pyro.description: The first Flamethrower use each turn will leave this unit with 1 AP. Flamethrowers deal -3 damage and gain +5 charges.

ram.name: Ram
ram.description: When this unit moves at least 6 tiles to an enemy, this unit will deal x melee damage, where x is 1/2 of the distance moved + 1 for every 10 max HP this unit has.

reactive-targeting-sensors.name: Reactive Targeting Sensors
reactive-targeting-sensors.description: Once per enemy turn, if this unit is idle or on overwatch and is targeted by a standard attack (shot or melee): this unit gains +20% DR against that attack, returns fire with a +20 aim reaction shot, and then enters One For All (if able). [Basic reaction shots lower cover DR/def by half and cannot crit]

repair-servos.name: Repair Servos
repair-servos.description: Repairs damage sustained in battle: When damaged, gain servos equal to 50% of the damage sustained. Each servo can heal 1 HP. At end of turn, use 20% of the servos available (minimum 1) and then lose 1 servo. Active servos are removed if this unit is fully healed or corroded.

repulsor.name: Repulsor
repulsor.description: If at full HP, non-psionic attacks are repulsed, causing them to graze (dealing only half of the original damage).

sentry.name: Sentry
sentry.description: Reaction shots deal +50% base weapon damage. If idle or on overwatch, grants +50 crit resist against the first damage taken each turn.

neural-damping.name: Neural Damping
neural-damping.description: Grants immunity to panic. Reduces psionic damage received by 30%.

smart-macrophages.name: Smart Macrophages
smart-macrophages.description: Grants complete immunity to corrosion and shredding.

advanced-perception.name: Advanced Perception
advanced-perception.description: Shots against flying targets gain +10 aim. This unit can react faster to incoming fire, causing 25% of incoming shots to graze, dealing half their original damage.

predictive-tracking.name: Predictive Tracking
predictive-tracking.description: Reaction shots gain +10 aim. Bulletstorm gains +6% hit chance (+3% with an LMG).

dual-heart.name: Dual Heart
dual-heart.description: Increases throw range by 15% and reduces scatter by 30%. If above half HP, fatal non-psionic damage reduces this unit to 1 HP instead. Causes soldiers to bleed out instead of dying the first time they fall in a mission. The bleed-out timer is extended by 5 turns.

adrenal-neurosympathy.name: Adrenal Neurosympathy
adrenal-neurosympathy.description: When this soldier takes an action, there is a chance (5% per enemy in sight) that the soldier emits pheromones for all allies in LoS that grant 10 aim, 5 crit, and 1.3 mob for 2 turns, and remove panic. 5 turn cooldown.

enhanced-metabolism.name: Enhanced Metabolism
enhanced-metabolism.description: Fire an additional reaction shot during overwatch. Equipped grenades and medikits receive an additional use. When below 50% HP, gain +4 mobility and +40 defense.

iron-skin.name: Iron Skin
iron-skin.description: Grants +10 base DR and +20 crit resistance.

muscle-amp.name: Muscle Amp
muscle-amp.description: Grants superhuman leg strength, enabling the soldier to reach high positions without the need for ladders or other climbing aids.

regenesis.name: Regenesis
regenesis.description: This unit has 15% less injury and fatigue time. Regenerates 1 base (non-armor) HP each turn (amount can vary on certain aliens/Exalt). Grants immunity to Bleeding.

countercharge.name: Countercharge
countercharge.description: Triggers a psionic attack against visible biological enemies that perform a non-movement end-in-idle action. The attack deals half of standard psionic damage (Will/30, +1 for every 10 target current HP) (with a 2% chance for double) and disorients the target but will never kill the target (will leave target with at least 1 HP). The chance to trigger is will/4 percent. Requires the caster to be idle and at full base HP.

mind-fray.name: Mind Fray
mind-fray.description: Removes combat readiness from the target and, if the target's will is overcome, deals standard psionic damage (Will/30, +1 for every 10 target current HP), -25 aim/will, -25% mobility/ability range, and +25% scatter. Damage is reduced by 50% if caster is staggered. Hit chance is calculated using 80% of will. Purely mechanical units are immune. Lasts through 2 enemy turns. 2 turn cooldown.

psi-panic.name: Psi Panic
psi-panic.description: Removes combat readiness from the target and, if the target's will is overcome, causes the target to panic. Hit chance is calculated using 50% of will. Purely mechanical units are immune. 4 turn cooldown.

kinetic-blast.name: Kinetic Blast
kinetic-blast.description: Channel energy up to 10 tiles away (through walls) to create a kinetic (non-psionic) blast with a 2 tile radius and no fall off. Deals 4 + will/30 kinetic (non-psionic) damage. Destroys corpses but does not affect cover. 3 turn cooldown.

psi-inspire.name: Psi Inspire
psi-inspire.description: Inspires allied soldiers within a 6 radius area near the caster for 1 turn. Cleanses Mind Fray, Disorient, Shaken, Panic, Fear, and Red Fog. Grants Inspired allies +10 aim and +30 Will. 2 turn cooldown.

fervor.name: Fervor
fervor.description: Grants +5 will per enemy in sight.

inner-fire.name: Inner Fire
inner-fire.description: Grants +20% throw range and +2.0 mobility. Regenerates 2 base (non-armor) HP each turn. Fire an additional reaction shot during overwatch and gain immunity to bleeding. Psionic potential unlocks a deep connection to one's body.

telekinetic-field.name: Telekinetic Field
telekinetic-field.description: Project an 8.5 radius protective field that grants +20 defense to all allies in the field. Non-psionic attacks against allies in the field deal only 80% of original damage. Mechanical enemies that enter the field take half of standard psionic damage (Will/30, +1 for every 10 target current HP). 3 turn cooldown.

psi-mastery.name: Psi Mastery
psi-mastery.description: All psionic abilities cost only 1 AP. If above half HP, fatal non-psionic damage reduces this unit to 1 HP instead. Psychic Storm still activates at half damage when interrupted.
